tei:div.tei:p: (pha)༄༅// 'jigs byed phyag drug pa'i sgrub thabs bzhugs// ༄༅// dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed phyag drug pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang gshin rje gshed la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di bsgom par 'dod pas stan bde ba la bsdad/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la lan gsum du skyabs 'gro bya/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i don du gshin rje gshed bsgom snyam du byang chub kyi sems yun ring du bsgom/ de nas/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhassarba dharmā ss+wa bhā wa shuddho3 haṃ/ zhes brjod pas bdag dang snang ba thams cad stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las padma ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros pas/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rwa ba/ drwa ba/ gur/ bla re/ bskal pa'i me lta bu'i ye shes kyi me ri 'bar bar grub par bsams la/ oṃ badzra rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes brjod pas byin gyis brlab/ de'i nang du/ e las chos kyi 'byung gnas mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor yangs pa'i nang du/ yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ ram̐ las khrag zhag 'khrugs pa'i rgya mtsho'i dbus su/ pam̐ las padma ram̐ las nyi ma'i gdan la dhīḥlas 'phags pa 'jam dpal zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas ral gri g.yon pusti 'dzin par bsam/ de'i thugs ka'i dhīḥlas 'od 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs ka nas gshin rje gshed kyi khro bo dpag tu med pa spyan drangs pa/ 'jam dpal la thim zhing yongs su gyur pa las/ rwa dang rmig pa sngo zhing*/ mig me mdag gi phung po ltar dmar ba'i ma he'i steng du rang nyid rdo rje 'jigs byed zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa sku mdog mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa zhal ma he'i gdong pa can g.yas dkar g.yon dmar ba/

zhal re re zhing spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa thugs kar 'dzin zhing*/ bar pa gnyis kyis ḍā ma ru dang*/ kha ṭwāṃ ga dang*/ 'og ma gnyis kyis glang po che'i ko rlon brgyangs nas gos su gon pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal dang*/ rus pa dang*/ rin po che dang dug sbrul gyis brgyan zhing*/ liṅga dmar po gyen du rgyas pa/ gcer bu ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par bsam pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying gar hūm̐ bsams nas/ snying gi nang gi hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas gshin rje gshed rigs lnga la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pas bskor ba spyan drangs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta zhes kun la sbyar la/ arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hās mchod yon/ pā dyaṃ pra tītstsha swā hās zhabs bsil/ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐ gis me tog badzra dhū pe āḥhūm̐ gis bdug spos/ badzra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐ gis mar me/ badzra gandhe āḥhūm̐ gis dri/ badzra nai wi dye āḥhūm̐ gis zhal zas/ badzra shapta āḥhūm̐ gis rol mo rnams phul nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis/ oṃ badzra u da ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing*/ bum pa'i chus dbang bskur bas lus thams cad gang*/ sdig pa dang*/ dri ma thams cad dag dbang bzhi thob/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan par bsam/ de nas dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes brjod pas/ dbang gi lha rnams ye shes pa'i tshul gyis bdag la bstim nas/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo bdag yin snyam du bsgoms la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wāka tsitta badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod/ lha'i sku snang la rang bzhin med pa la yid gtad la sems mnyam par gzhag go

/de nas snying gi nang gi hūm̐ gi mtha' mar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba'i 'od kyis/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi rgyud bskul bas bdag byin gyis brlabs nas/ sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad dag tshe dang bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs spel bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ ya mānta ka hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ hrīḥṣṭ+rīḥwi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces ci nus pas bzla'o// de nas gtor ma bshams pa hrīḥṣṭ+rīs bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ āḥlas thod pa'i nang du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor bsams la/ snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ rang 'dra ba'i gshin rje gshed la/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang*/ las kyi gshin rje la sogs pa phyogs skyong ba rnams kyis bskor ba spyan drangs pa la gtor ma phul bas gsol bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ hrīḥṣṭ+rīḥwi kṛ tā na na sarba bighnān sha trūṃ mā ra ya/ i daṃ ba liṃ grihnā pa ya grihnā pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces lan gsum mam bdun gyis dbul/ arghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ gshin rje gshed po 'khor bcas kun// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// tshe ring nad med dbang phyug dang*// dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang*// longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*// zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod kyi// las kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// zhes gsol ba gdab/ mthar gtor ma'i mgron gshegs su gsol/ zas oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs nas rang ya mānta kar dmigs pa'i snying gar/ bla ma dkon mchog dang*/ lte bar 'byung po'i tshogs dmigs la mchod pa'i bsam pas bza'/ spyod lam gyi tshe/ bdag dang snang ba thams cad lha/ brjod pa dang grag pa thams cad sngags/ sems kyi rnam par rtog pa thams cad ye shes kyi cho 'phrul dang*/ thams cad kyang rmi lam sgyu ma lta bur shes pas kun tu spyod do// nub mo nyal ba'i tshe/

chos thams cad stong pa'i ngang la nyal zhing*/ ldang ba'i tshe bdag nyid ya mānta ka dang*/ snang ba thams cad dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lor shes pas ldang ngo*// tshul 'di ltar rtag tu bsgoms na/ gnas skabs su bgegs dang bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi zhing*/ mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par 'gyur ro// de ltar ya mānta ka'i sgrub pa'i thabs// 'phags pas lung dang man ngag bzhin bsdebs nas// a rog che la phul 'di nyams su bzhes// lha 'di khyod kyi skyob pa chen por 'gyur// lcags mo lug gi lo zla ba lnga pa'i tshes nyi shu lnga la shin kun gyi sa char sbyar ba'o// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
